| # UDS Routine Control {#uds-routine-control-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |                                                                                                                                             |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Routine Control Service can be configured in easyConfig with

 1)  Start a Routine (Sub Function 0x01).

 2)  Stop a Routine (Sub Function 0x02).

 3)  Get a result (Sub Function 0x03).

## Configuration Parameters available in easyConfig for Routine Control {#configuration-parameters-available-in-easyconfig-for-routine-control .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  -------------------- --------------- --------------------------- ----------- ------------------------------------------------------------
  Parameter Name       Default value   Range                       Mandatory   Description
  Routine Name         N.A             N.A                         Yes         Unique name has to be provided for each routine.
  Routine Identifier   N.A             0x0200 - 0xDFFF             Yes         This parameter identifies a server routine.
  Routine Type         N.A             Start,Stop and Get Result   Yes         Type of routine.
  Callback             N.A             N.A                         Yes         Callback function name for respective Routine.
  IN Signal Length     N.A             0x0000-0x7FD8               Yes         Routine Control Option record (input data) length in bits.
  OUT Signal Length    N.A             0x0000-0x7FD8               Yes         Routine Status record (output data) length in bits.
  -------------------- --------------- --------------------------- ----------- ------------------------------------------------------------

N.A - Not Applicable.
